name: Our Appearance
overview: Scripture reveals that our appearance is a reflection of being created in God's image, as seen in Genesis where man and woman are formed after His likeness, endowed with dignity and purpose. Our bodies are fearfully and wonderfully made, deserving of honor and respect, which is why God commands against altering our flesh or adopting garments that contradict our created design. True beauty is not merely outward but is connected to discretion and godly character, emphasizing that how we present ourselves should align with reverence for God's creation and His standards.
